parts.text: Turn the axe handle (the long wooden shaft he grips with both hands) into polished gold: a shiny gold-plated handle with a warm metallic gold sheen, same shape and length. Keep the chrome axe head with its blood exactly as is. Keep everything else identical: his face, slicked hair, suit, red tie, clear raincoat, both hands gripping the handle, penthouse skyline backdrop, clay style. No text.
